delete.description:
Deletes an admin or auditor user using the specified ID

Note: This request deletes an admin and removes them as a user from the ZIA Admin Portal. To delete the admin privileges for a user while retaining them as a regular user of your organization in the ZIA Admin Portal, use the POST /adminUsers/{userId}/convertToUser request.


Sample Request (Python)
import http.client
import json

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("HOSTNAME")

headers = {
    'content-type': "application/json",
    'cache-control': "no-cache",
    'cookie': "JSESSIONID=xxxxxxx"
}

conn.request("DELETE", "/api/v1/adminUsers/6794036", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

Sample Response
204 No Content

get.description: Retrieves information about the current administrator or auditor user, or both

post.description:
Removes admin privileges for a user while retaining them as a regular user of your organization in the ZIA Admin Portal. This can be used as an alternative to the DELETE /adminUsers/{userId} request, which deletes an admin and removes them as a user from the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn more, see Deleting ZIA Admins.

Before you can delete the admin privileges for a user, you need to obtain the admin user's ID and other information by using the GET /users request and then send the admin user details in the POST /adminUsers/{userId}/convertToUser request.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the admin user
Information about the user for whom the admin privileges must be removed. Group information is mandatory in the request Body. Optionally, you can include other field information to modify the values.
parameters.name: body

passwordExpirationEnabled.description: Specifies whether password expiration is enabled for the admin

passwordExpiryDays.description: Password expiration duration, calculated in days

AdminRole.description: Specifies an admin's level of access to the ZIA Admin Portal

rank.description: Admin rank of this admin role. This is applicable only when the admin rank is enabled in the advanced settings. Default value is 7 (the lowest rank). The assigned admin rank determines the roles or admin users this user can manage and the rule orders the admin can access.

usernameAccess.description: Username access permission. When set to NONE, the username is obfuscated.

deviceInfoAccess.description: Device information access permission. When set to NONE, device information is obfuscated.

adminAcctAccess.description: Admin and role management access permission

isAuditor.description: Indicates whether this is an auditor role

permissions.description: List of functional areas to which this role has access. This attribute is subject to change.

featurePermissions.description: Feature access permission. Indicates which features an admin role can access and if the admin has both read and write access, or read-only access.

extFeaturePermissions.description: External feature access permission. Indicates whether an admin role has full or restricted access to external features. When set to NONE, the admin role does not have permission to access any external features.

isNonEditable.description: Indicates whether or not this admin user is editable

logsLimit.description: Enter the number of days an admin with this role can view logs. Admins can view real-time logs of every transaction performed by your users regardless of where they are in the world.

roleType.description: The admin role type. This attribute is subject to change.

reportTimeDuration.description:
Time duration allocated to the report dashboard. The default value of -1 indicates that no time restriction is applied to the
 report dashboard. Time Unit is in hours.

loginName.description: Admin or auditor's login name. The login name is in email format and uses the domain name associated with the Zscaler account.

role.description: Role of the admin. This is not required for an auditor.

comments.description: Additional information about the admin or auditor

adminScope.description: The admin's scope. A scope is required for the admins, but not applicable to auditors. This attribute is subject to change.

isNonEditable.description: Indicates whether or not the admin can be edited or deleted

disabled.description: Indicates whether or not the admin account is disabled

isAuditor.description: Indicates whether the user is an auditor. This attribute is subject to change.

password.description: The admin's password. If the single sign-on (SSO) for the admin is disabled, then this field is mandatory for POST requests. This information is not provided in a GET response.

isPasswordLoginAllowed.description: The default value is true when SAML Authentication is disabled. When SAML Authentication is enabled, this can be set to false to force the admin to log in via SSO only.

isSecurityReportCommEnabled.description: Enables or disables communication regarding security updates. Enable this to receive the latest information on vulnerabilities and threats that might affect your organization.

isServiceUpdateCommEnabled.description: Enables or disables communication regarding service updates. Enable this to receive new Zscaler service and product enhancements, including new data center notification and cloud release information.

isProductUpdateCommEnabled.description: Enables or disables communication regarding product updates. Enable if you want the admin to receive communication regarding important changes and updates for the Zscaler service.

isPasswordExpired.description: Indicates whether or not an admin's password has expired

isExecMobileAppEnabled.description: Indicates whether or not the Executive Insights App access is enabled for the admin

execMobileAppTokens.description: Read-only information about the Executive Insights App token, if it exists.

newLocationCreateAllowed.description: Determines if the user is allowed to create a new location

name.description:
User name. This appears when choosing users for policies.

Note: The name field allows values containing UTF-8 characters up to a maximum of 127 characters.

email.description:
User email consists of a user name and domain name. It does not have to be a valid email address, but it must be unique and its domain must belong to the organization.

Note: The email field allows values of alphanumeric characters and certain special characters up to a maximum of 127 characters. The use of the @ symbol is mandatory. This field corresponds to the User ID (also referred to as Login ID) field in the UI. However, the data validation in the UI uses different constraints.

groups.description: List of Groups a user belongs to. Groups are used in policies.

tempAuthEmail.description: Temporary Authentication Email. If you enabled one-time tokens or links, enter the email address to which the Zscaler service sends the tokens or links. If this is empty, the service sends the email to the User email.

password.description: User's password. Applicable only when authentication type is Hosted DB. Password strength must follow what is defined in the auth settings.

adminUser.description: True if this user is an Admin user

type.description: User type. Provided only if this user is not an end user.

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of an ID and name

scopeGroupMemberEntities.description: Only applicable for the LOCATION_GROUP admin scope type, in which case this attribute gives the list of ID/name pairs of locations within the location group. The attribute name is subject to change.

Type.description: The admin scope type. The attribute name is subject to change.

ScopeEntities.description: Based on the admin scope type, the entities can be the ID/name pair of departments, locations, or location groups. The attribute name is subject to change.

AdminScope.description: An admin's scope can be limited to certain resources, policies, or reports. An admin's scope can be limited by LOCATION, LOCATION GROUP, or DEPARTMENT. If this is not specified, then the admin has an ORGANIZATION scope by default.

MobileAppTokenInfo.description: Executive Insights App device token information.

idpId.description: Unique identifier for the identity provider (IdP)
Identity provider (IdP) ID. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

comments.description: Additional information about this department. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.
